units: B. Kam. 79ᵇ; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. מְזוּמָּן, f. מְזוּמֶּנֶת; pl. מְזוּמָּנִים, מְזוּמָּנוֹת
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 41:1">Pesik. R. s. 41</cite>, end <he>מי שהוא מ׳ לסעודה</he> he who is invited to the feast.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 41:1">Ib.</cite> (expl. <he>מקראי</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 48:12">Is. XLVIII, 12</cite>) <he>מְזוּמָּנִי</he> My invited guest (Israel); a. e.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Berakhot 43a">Ber. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>הוא מ׳ לברכה</he> he is the one designated (by the host) to say grace.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 17a:15">Ab. Zar. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>מז׳ לחיי וכ׳</he> chosen for the bliss of futurity.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 102a:4">Snh. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>עת היא מ׳ וכ׳</he> there is a time designated for &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 102a">Ib.</cite> <he>יום מזומן</he> (not <he>עת היא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 330">Yalk. Is. 330</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 330">ib.</cite> Jer. 287.—
senses.label: b

units: B. Mets. 102ᵃ; Sifré Deut. 227, a. e. כי יקרא פרט למ׳ ‘if it chance’ (Deut. XXII, 6) this excludes that which is at thy disposal (in thy court yard); a. e.—2) to appoint a meal in common, so as to say grace together; to preface the grace after meal by saying, Let us praise &c.; v. זִימּוּן.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 7:1">Ber. VII, 1</cite> <he>שלשה … חייבין לזַמֵּן</he> if three dine together, they are bound to make an appointment for common grace.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 7:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מְזַמְּנִין עליו</he> common grace may be appointed by making him one of the party (offering him something to eat).

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 7:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אין מ׳ עליהן</he> you cannot count them in (to make up the requisite number). Ib. 2 <he>עד כמה מזמנין</he> how much must one eat of the meal in order to be counted one of the company? Ib. 3 <he>כיצד מ׳</he> how is the appeal for common grace made?; a. fr.
senses.label: c

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 7:1">Dem. VII, 1</cite> <he>המַזְמִין את הבירו וכ׳</he> if one notifies his friend that he will dine with him (on the Sabbath).
<cite ref="Berakhot 26a:5">Ber. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>הִזְמִינוֹ וכ׳</he> if he designated a building for &c.

senses.gloss: to meet, to come to hand (providentially); to join one’s self to.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 96a">Snh. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>אותו מלאך שנ׳ לו וכ׳</he> that angel who was commissioned to accompany Abraham.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>נ׳ לו רגלי אחד</he> a footman was joined to him (to meet his challenge).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 25b">Ab. Zar. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>ישראל שנ׳ לו וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Chullin 91a:15">Ḥull. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>שנטפל</he>) an Israelite whom a gentile joins on the road.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 7:4">Shebi. VII, 4</cite> <he>שנִזְדַּמְּנוּ להם וכ׳</he> who accidentally caught unclean animals; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to make an appointment for meeting one another.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 33:1">Pesik. R. s. 33</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00363"><he>זִימּוּן</he></cite>.
